dict.string: Oreja de Van Gogh — an independent audio companion. Not affiliated with OpenAI or Apple.
Oreja listens to the audio output of the apps you select so it can pause or lower playback while they speak. Audio is analyzed locally as level only; nothing is recorded, stored, or uploaded.

Only if you turn on “Apply the interruption while I speak”: Oreja measures your microphone level so selected media stays paused or lowered while you talk. Audio never leaves your Mac and nothing is recorded.
Oreja controls Music and, when selected, browser tabs to lower or pause media while a primary audio source speaks. It only changes standard media playback and does not read page content.
